registered with Roborough Surgery back in September to seek advice regarding an existing diagnosis. Since then, my experience has been extremely disappointing.

I do not feel I am being taken seriously at all. Despite clearly having ongoing health concerns, no proper physical examinations have been carried out, and my worries feel brushed aside. There is a complete lack of emotional care or reassurance from both the doctors and reception staff, which is very distressing when you are already anxious about your health.

The systems in place are very poor. It is nearly impossible to book an appointment within a reasonable time frame. You can wait over three weeks just to be contacted, only to then be referred to a GP for an initial appointment. The delays are unacceptable.

Reception staff often come across as uncaring and unhelpful, which only adds to the frustration. Overall, the lack of urgency, compassion, and basic care has left me feeling unsupported.

Because of this, I am now having to spend a significant amount of money and consider going private just to get the help I need. I would not recommend this surgery to anyone who needs timely or compassionate That year was 1967. 58yrs ago.
This year, my father who is 93yrs old & is suffering from prostate cancer, has suffered with ill health, in particular with breathing issues. On Friday  27th June, 2025, my brother contacted the surgery on order to make an appointment to see a Dr.  He was told that due to their 'triage' system, a Dr would contact him by phone on or around the 15th July!!! How can you make any form of diagnosis about a breathing issue in a 93yr old man who is partially deaf, over the phone!! I travelled down from Norfolk on Monday, 30th January & went straight to the surgery. I complained about the lack of help re my dad & that a phone consultation was inadequate, particularly bearing in mind my dad is pretty deaf,  even with hearing aids. I was told to fill in a request via 'the app',on line!! The following day i contacted 111 & my dad was seen within 3hrs. Diagnosed with heart failure he was given limited medication. Since that date, he has now been told that the cancer has spread to his bones & that there is little they can do. Fast forward to Monday 6th October,  due to my dad's breathing worsening he was admitted to Derriford hospital. He spent the week there recovering. He was looked after really well and as a result his breathing has improved. He has a review in December 2025 re his medication. He had his last face to face review in 2017! I've just sent a message via the surgeries website asking that the review is face to face. I simply do not understand how an elderly man with breathing issues has never been seen by a Dr. When I complained, I mentioned then, all I wanted was for my dad to be seen by a Dr.  That simply fell on deaf ears. Ironically, on that visit, there was one person in the waiting room!! Absolutely ridiculous!!! In Norfolk  we haven't got this ridiculous triage system in place! You actually ring the surgery & where you can, make an appointment! You remember, just like it used to be!! Roborough surgery, I have no faith in you to be able to look after my dad. The only people to have done that this year, are the brilliant staff at Derriford hospital. A huge thank you to them. I'm pleased to say that my dad is doing ok now thst he's back at home & is being visited twice daily by brilliant carers,  who show nothing but compassipn & professionalism in their job role. It's no wonder Roborough surgery only has a 2.7 star review. That says it all!! Get back to being a caring service like it once was, instead of fobbing your patients off.
